The first reply states: "a lot of people who want to date 21 year olds are big mad about this one lol," with 28 likes, 44 retweets, and 3,098 replies. The second reply clarifies: "to clarify, i don't think jails should exist, it is my own preference to not date 21 year olds, not a rule for everyone else, though i do think large age differentials are creepy and coercive," with 97 likes, 246 retweets, and 4,323 replies.
